correctness.rationale: Exact independent-clade variance and derivative; a scale-separated induction preserves an arbitrary number of positive-to-negative sign intervals, with polynomial analyticity making extrema strict. Every zero refinement edge can be made strictly positive by continuous perturbation. A fully binary explicit three-peak tree has six outward-rounded sign witnesses and a uniform derivative perturbation error under 1.6e-7, below the 0.5 sign margin. The finite program is corroboration, not proof of the universal claim.

value.rationale: Genuinely structural: no universal unimodality/mode-number bound for extinction-risk variance, despite universal monotone-concave expected rooted PD. Multiple clade-length scales produce rigorously independent variability windows on fully binary positive-edge trees, with a completely reproducible three-peak witness. This supplies a motivated counterexample to one-peak risk intuition, not a table recomputation.
